pos.personaBrief: Telê wanted the ball (Menotti's 60% recollection, 4-2-2-2 with high possession per pt.wikipedia, 'bola no chão') and rejected long balls and sterile possession; he deliberately sat deeper v Bragantino in 1991 only as an exception.

pro.personaBrief: He rejected high balls as a method ('Não é melhor ver isso do que ver dar pontapé') and wanted technique first, yet criticised sterile back-passing and wanted attack with audacity and fast transitions.

est.personaBrief: He admired Holland 1974 where everyone moved and played anywhere; Cafu, Leonardo and Antônio Carlos were freed, with constant position swaps (Cafu and Müller), though a 4-2-2-2 base existed.

lar.personaBrief: The 4-2-2-2 had no classic wingers; full-backs (Vitor, Ronaldo Luiz, Cafu, Zé Teodoro) went forward and crossed after daily cross training, while Raí and Müller worked inside.

blo.personaBrief: Raí and the stars had to chase and tackle 'como um europeu' (1992), and the team was hard-working, but Telê also sat deeper v Bragantino and did not build on a systematic high-press doctrine.

mar.personaBrief: No source states zonal or man-marking; only ball-oriented collective winning back of the ball and Holland-74 style fluidity, which leans toward zonal and shared responsibility.

pla.personaBrief: He preferred to strengthen his own team over designing schemes against opponents and imposed his model, but made pragmatic adjustments (Bragantino 1991, three volantes v Newell's 1993).

res.personaBrief: He called the beautiful-v-winning dilemma a balela and wanted both, but results were not enough: 'Isso não me satisfaz' for ugly wins; he wanted good football and spectacle, and played to win.

sis.personaBrief: Technique first, stars must work to win the ball back (Raí, Cruyff example), fluid roles for chosen players; talent gets freedom within collective effort and everyone does their job.

jog.personaBrief: 'Primeiro é o técnico': daily fundamentals training, Cafu taught to cross, Raí the creative leader, though he also demanded work rate and physical condition.

bas.personaBrief: He bet on Cafu, Leonardo, Antônio Carlos, Elivelton and built the Expressinho of boys, but won with Raí, Ricardo Rocha and experienced players and changed squad each season.

lid.personaBrief: 'Eu sou duro' and 'não admito indisciplina', Zé Teodoro dropped from a trip, but he consulted senior players before the 1991 final and spoke with them.
